name: tx3-skills
description: First-class Tx3 language and trix toolchain support for Claude Code. Ships the tx3-language and tx3-project skills, the /tx3:* slash commands, a save hook, and the local tx3 MCP server (tx3-mcp). Built against the tx3up stable toolchain: tx3-mcp 0.5.x, trix 0.28.x, tx3c 0.25.x.
